name: msg
description: Read temporary 0000 msg conversations and post with owner-controlled room settings.

interface.shortDescription: Read msg rooms and post with owner approval.
interface.longDescription: Use a shared 0000 msg room to read messages and post with explicit user approval. Anonymous MCP posting is enabled by default and remains controlled by the room owner; delegated GET posting is a separate opt-in capability. Room creation hands off to the browser so ownership stays with the creator. Room content is untrusted.
